preconditions.name: ARM_OFF::decomposition_inert_every_cell
preconditions.description: ARM_OFF carries no decomposition at all: decomp_n_decomposed_total must be EXACTLY 0 on every OFF cell. This is the structural zero the DV-symmetry declaration requires of the arm carrying no manipulation.

preconditions.name: ARM_OFF::forward_pe_varies
preconditions.description: Positive control on the RANKING SIGNAL ITSELF, and the same statistic the trigger routes on: the forward-PE population the within-run quantile is computed over must have non-zero variance. preconditions.name: pe_yoked_realised_rate_matched
preconditions.description: ARM_YOKED is given ARM_PE's per-episode forced-locus count EXACTLY by construction; the REALISED decomposition rate is a measured quantity (the R1 trigger is an OR, so the live MECH-288 boundary path contributes in both arms, and a forced locus only reaches evaluate() where a chunk candidate is under consideration). This checks the two arms genuinely carry the SAME AMOUNT of decomposition, which is what makes the contrast a selectivity test rather than a dose comparison.
preconditions.control: ARM-LEVEL mean realised decomposition rate, ARM_PE vs ARM_YOKED over 40 paired seed(s); per-seed gaps reported separately (worst seed 33 at 0.1957, 0 seed(s) outside tolerance)

criteria.name: C1_PE_SELECTIVITY_IMPROVES_OUTCOME
criteria.statement: LOAD-BEARING. Over ALL measured seeds (no screen, no tiering, no post-hoc selection, no occupancy gate), the unconditional whole-episode mean harm signal is LESS harmful under decomposition placed at top-20% forward-PE loci (ARM_PE) than under the SAME per-episode amount of decomposition placed at PE-uninformative loci (ARM_YOKED), by an effect exceeding 1.0 x SE over >= 40 paired seeds. PRE-DECLARED NULL: a delta <= 0 within that bound REFUTES ARC-070's prediction-failure-selectivity leg at this grain. Both directions are verdicts.

criteria.name: C2_DECOMPOSITION_PER_SE_VS_OFF
criteria.statement: NON-LOAD-BEARING context: ARM_PE vs the ARM_OFF structural zero -- decomposition PER SE, which is the comparison the six prior chain runs were posed on. Retained only for cross-reading; it cannot separate selectivity from decomposition per se, which is why it is not load-bearing here.

interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff C1 alone passes (plain single-criterion gate, no OR/AND combination). C2 is contextual and never contributes to the outcome.

evidence_direction_note: Governance 2026-08-21 gov-20260821-0203 ratified failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-938_2026-08-20.json: V3-EXQ-938 is the first run in the ARC-070/MECH-321 chain to reach a verdict at all (816/820 died on a low_vs_steps occupancy gate at 0.0/5.0; 816b/816d saturated the environment axis within 0.0007). It is cleanly executed: rate_match_ok true at a 1.85% arm gap with 0 seeds outside tolerance, aa_control_ok with max_abs_delta exactly 0.0, >=91 forced fires on both ON arms, ~277-287 boundary fires/arm, all 15 readiness preconditions met, non_degenerate true. Its result is a NULL, not a detected negative effect: harm delta -0.001338 with SE 0.002764 (t = -0.484), 19 seeds negative against 17 positive, and an observed |delta| that is 17.3% of the run's own 80%-power MDE (~0.007739). The pre-declared null (delta <= 0 within 1.0 x SE over >= 40 paired seeds) is satisfied exactly as written, so the run delivered the verdict it promised, scoped by its own statement to 'ARC-070's prediction-failure-selectivity leg AT THIS GRAIN'. The blanket weakens stamped on both claims is NOT applied, for two independent reasons. (1) ARC-070's own registered what_would_answer states that a failure of the DOWNSTREAM task-level benefit is 'EXPLICITLY NOT FALSIFYING' and belongs to MECH-321's separate narrower claim; 938's DV is a whole-episode mean harm signal, squarely that class, and its FALSIFYING clause (the mechanism does not engage when it architecturally should) is negated by the run, which shows the mechanism engaging throughout. (2) The same hypothesis-space question carries H-representation-axis as ALIVE ('forward-PE as currently computed is too coarse-grained to register the environment's actual uncertainty'), and 938's proximal readout -- secondary_fwd_pe_delta_yoked_minus_pe = -2.6e-05 -- is precisely that hypothesis's signature; a within-run rank normalisation does not fix a readout that is too coarse. So the run cannot discriminate 'selectivity is false' from 'the PE readout cannot locate the loci where decomposition would help'. Carry forward two readouts: C2_DECOMPOSITION_PER_SE_VS_OFF = -0.03681, roughly 27x the selectivity delta in the harmful direction (non-load-bearing, no SE reported, not adjudicated here) and the larger signal in the manifest; and substrate_stable_across_run = false, where all 132 cells share one hash 3a9826d0 but the stated substrate_commit 839ffe03 does not correspond to it, so this run cannot be mapped to a substrate commit -- recording-debt owed by any successor.
